title: Container Scripts Manifest Schema
description: JSON Schema for container scripts manifest file that maps source files to installation targets

version.description: Schema version using semantic versioning (MAJOR.MINOR format)

description.description: Human-readable description of the manifest file purpose

files.description: Array of file entries mapping source files to installation targets

fileEntry.description: File entry mapping a source file to an installation target with metadata

source.description: Relative path to source file from container-scripts/ directory. Must not start with '/' (relative path only)

target.description: Target path where file will be installed. Can be absolute (e.g., /usr/local/bin/script.sh) or relative (e.g., ./script.sh) for build-time scripts

file_type.description: Category classification of the file type

permissions.description: Octal permission string (3-4 digits, 0-7). Typically 0644 for config files, 0755 for executable scripts

block.description: Numeric block identifier indicating which build block this file belongs to

block_name.description: Human-readable name of the build block
examples: APT-ARIA WRAPPER SETUP (MUST BE BEFORE NVIDIA!)
DESKTOP ENVIRONMENT AND REMOTE ACCESS SETUP (Part 1 of 3)

description.description: Human-readable description of the file's purpose and installation target
examples: MKL environment verification script for HPC validation

dependencies.description: Array of source file paths that this file depends on. Currently unused but reserved for future dependency resolution

line_start.description: Starting line number in source script where this file's content begins. Use null for standalone files not extracted from source script

line_end.description: Ending line number in source script where this file's content ends. Use null for standalone files not extracted from source script

delimiter.description: Heredoc delimiter string used to extract file content from source script. Use null for standalone files not extracted from source script

file_path.description: Absolute path to source script file containing this file's content. Use null for standalone files not extracted from source script
